messages:
lia: Heads-up — ran the q4b-8bit bringup on the new synth anchor set, seeing a ~3.6% drop on paraphrase recall vs float32 on long prompts. not huge but consistent.
omer: Can you paste the failing examples? rough sketch is fine.
lia: Pasted a few below — mostly long-context synonyms and ordering. 
---
Example 1: 'How do I reset my 2FA on account with multiple devices?' -> float top: steps A->B->C, quant variant: suggests contacting support only.
Example 2: long legalese paraphrase where quant drops a clause.
---
lia: I suspect tokenizer bloat + kv-cache truncation interacting with quant kernel rounding.
tara: Hmm. Did you run the dedupe/anchor overlap test? maybe anchors missing and holdouts shifted.
lia: Ran a quick overlap: ~4% of anchors got dropped by our fingerprint dedupe after tokenization with the new tokenizer config.
cheng: That matches a drift note from the tokenizer change last week. We changed whitespace normalization.
omer: OK — two action tracks: 1) immediate: bridge holdout heuristics to reduce false negatives in evaluation; 2) medium: regen anchor set with tokenizer-aware fingerprints.
jess: For (1) what do you mean by bridge heuristics?
omer: Heuristic idea: when sampling holdouts, allow fuzz matches by normalized edit distance on token sequences + embedding cosine > 0.92 to retain near-duplicates that fingerprinting misses. fallback to labeler review for borderline cases.
kai: I can prototype a sampling SQL to surface candidates. Something like: 
```sql
SELECT id, text, embed FROM candidates
WHERE embed_cosine(embed, anchor_embed) > 0.92
AND token_edit_distance(token_repr, anchor_token_repr) < 0.15
LIMIT 2000;
```

kai: Will push prototype to /etl/adhoc/bridge-sampler.ipynb
lia: Nice. For the labeler instructions — short notes: mark as "duplicate_by_meaning" if paraphrase or "distinct_clause_loss" if model is missing a clause. keep examples to 2-3 sentences.
label-bot: Reminder: new labeling schema added -> please use tag set v3 when creating batches.
tara: Also, can we add an automated pre-filter to reweight golden examples appearing fragile under quant? e.g., if quant vs float diff > threshold, add +1 weight for golden sampling for next round.
omer: Agree. We'll run a sweep: sample 5k candidates via bridge heuristic, run q4b and float evals, compute delta, upweight top 1k to golden-proposal pool.
cheng: Timeline?
jess: I can own labeler batch creation + instructions. estimate 2 days to get initial batches ready.
kai: Prototype sampler + notebook today/tomorrow, will post link.
omer: I'll set up a canary rollout: keep traffic on dedicated dev pool, compare outputs and collect trace IDs. fallback policy -> float on regression.
lia: Perfect. ping me when sampler link is up and when label batches exist. thanks. :thumbsup:
